title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch Solid Brass | Sea Foam Green | Vanity Top Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder 5.5-Inch, Sea Foam Green
description:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is limited—this vanity top toilet tissue holder adds convenient storage right on the counter in Sea Foam Green, which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces.

Highlights
- Save wall space in smaller bathrooms with a countertop vanity top design
- Keep a toilet paper roll accessible beside the sink for everyday use
- Choose long-lasting durability with solid brass construction
- Coordinate your look with the vanity top accessories collection and multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 x 6 x 5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 12 x 10 x 6 in.
- Shipping weight: 5 lbs
- Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
